title: Movable seams in root-of-unity XXZ chains: Relative flux classes and antiunitary spectral pairing
summary: Starting from the cyclic duality tensors introduced by Vernier, Miao, and Yamazaki (VMY), whose endpoint-traced matrix-product operators obey $\mathbb Z_N$ Tambara--Yamagami fusion and realize topological defect lines of the compactified-boson conformal field theory, we retain the virtual endpoint as an $N$-state dynamical degree of freedom and construct an exactly movable seam in the spin-$\tfrac12$ XXZ chain at $q=\mathrm e^{\mathrm iπM/N}$ with $\gcd(M,N)=1$.
